The application focuses on the North American market.
The application aims to protect users from credit/debit card fraud.
The application aims to save transaction fees for small vendors.
Falak Shah is the creator of the Meghnad application.

fact_previews: The proposal describes a mobile payment app using QR codes to streamline the payment process.
The app allows people to make payments with just a scan of a QR code.
The creator of the app had no technical background and had never written a line of code.
The creator educated themselves about the problem they were trying to solve and how QR codes were used in the payment industry.
The creator learned about how QR codes work, the benefits of contactless transactions, and the associated security concerns.

fact_previews: The app's design and user experience matched the creator's vision.
User personas were created and feedback was gathered from friends and acquaintances who represented typical app users.
Typical app users were described as busy, tech-savvy but not necessarily experts, and looking for a hassle-free way to pay.
The first prototype of the app was unveiled after several months of development.
The QR code-based payment system allows users to scan a merchant's code, confirm the amount, and complete the payment in seconds.
